notes.title: A new price!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

We just want to make it known that we have officially and permanently reduced the price of our games, Light Repair Team #4 and Fruit for the Village. These prices are permanent, and will not go away! Sales will still happen, as they appear, so please keep an eye on that.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/528930/Fruit_for_the_Village/]Fruit for the Village is now $2.99 USD[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/444530/Light_Repair_Team_4/]Light Repair Team #4 is now $4.99USD[/url]

We would also like to give a shout out to our Australian friends, you may see that your prices are a bit more reasonable compared to what you may usual expect.

We thank everyone for their support of us and our games and we wish you a happy end of the year. 

- Eerie Bear Games

notes.title: DEMO AVAILABLE TO TRY
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30574334/735d4ea57333e47c500f3b28775ffc6bc65bb61f.png[/img]

Just two weeks ahead of our launch on May 22nd, we've decided to give everyone an early taste to Fruit for the Village with a DEMO! (Click the "Download Demo" button over on the right to give it a shot)

This demo is a sample of gameplay from the story mode with randomized character options. It's just a taste, and the full game will allow you to experience the whole story of the Village, along with an endless survival mode (if story isn't your thing and you just want to play around) and additional character options, rather than randomized ones!

Again, Fruit for the Village launches on May 22nd, just two short weeks away. Don't forget to wishlist the game to get a notification of when we launch!

We hope you find this taste of Fruit for the Village sweet,

- Joe and Noah, Eerie Bear Games
